newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka estate shares dip on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka estate shares dip on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares of five plantation firms fell in early Thursday morning trade on retail profit-taking, brokers said.

Shares of Kelani Valley fell 2.90 percent or one rupee to 33.50, Agalawatte 2.86 percent or one rupee to 34, Bogawantalawa 2.41 percent or one rupee to 40.50 and Kotagala 1.45 percent or 50 cents to 34.
"Since the shares all rose sharply due to good profits in the 1996 financial year, retailers are taking profit," said a broker.
The five privatised estate firms make up the bulk of the plantation sector on the Colombo Stock Exchange.
